headline: Douglas Emmett Reports Q3 2026 Revenue Above Forecasts Amid West L.A. Focus
summary: Douglas Emmett beat revenue forecasts in the third quarter of 2026, highlighting its focus on West Los Angeles amidst the office market recovery.
why: Douglas Emmett is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on office and multifamily properties in premier coastal submarkets of Southern California.
